parts:
I think you might be running into an issue with the order of your arguments. All arguments to be passed to lavaan (e.g. ordered, group, group.equal) need to go at the end of the function call (if you look at the help file for runMI, the ... is the last argument).

Alex

Hi Amanda

Can you try running the model with only group.equal=c("loadings"), and then group.equal=c("thresholds"), to see if its only one of them that is creating the problem. Also, you can always set these constraints in the model syntax.

One more thing with WLSMV, you cannot estimate the MR chi-square, you should set chi="lmrr"

Hope this helps

On 05/08/2015 04:04 PM, Ashenafi wrote:
> Update: With similar syntax, it worked in another model. I have no idea
> about the reason.

All you can do to find out what exactly caused the problem with the
other model, is to type

traceback()

immediately after you get the error message. Look at the last function
name that was called (at the top), and then, if that function was
called, say, someFunction(), do

debug(someFunction)

and run it again. You will be able to step through that function line by
line, and at each step, you can inspect the values of the variable,,
matrices etc... Maybe, you can find out what goes wrong and triggers the
error.

Yves.
